question:
What is the simplified value of the following?

({9 div frac{3)/(7) {of} ( {9 + 6 times overline {4 - 2} } ) + [ {(1)/(5) div (7)/({25)} - left{ {(5)/(8) + (6)/({16)}} right}} ]}}{{24 div overline {16 - 10} + 36 div ( {5 + 20 div 4 - 1} )}}
solution:
**Concept used:**

B = Bar/Bracket

O = Of

D = Division

M = Multiplication

A = Addition

**Calculation:**

({9 div frac{3)/(7) {of} ( {9 + 6 times overline {4 - 2} } ) + [ {(1)/(5) div (7)/({25)} - left{ {(5)/(8) + (6)/({16)}} right}} ]}}{{24 div overline {16 - 10} + 36 div ( {5 + 20 div 4 - 1} )}}

⇒ ({9 div frac{3)/(7) {of} ( {9 + 6 times 2 } ) + [ {(1)/(5) div (7)/({25)} - left{ {(5)/(8) + (6)/({16)}} right}} ]}}{{24 div 6 + 36 div ( {5 + 20 div 4 - 1} )}}

⇒ ({9 div 9 + [ {frac{1)/(5) div (7)/({25)} - 1 }} ]}}{{24 div 6 + 36 div ( {5 + 5 - 1} )}}

⇒ ({1+ [ {frac{1)/(5) times (25)/({7)} - 1 }} ]}}{{4 + 36 div 9 }}

⇒ 1 -{2over 7}over 8

⇒ 5over56

**The answer is 5over56.**
